ttd.name: Olifant TTD
ttd.authority: Main ruled the South Africa line on 2026-11-02 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day: the TTD (Project Loggim's one Tank Technology Demonstrator, 1992) as the South African special at tier III (IV ruled, III by its same-tier duels); the owner, the same day: "the ttd needs to properly be based on an actual leopard 2". A first-party build on the fleet's Leopard 2 (the release's Leopard 2 hull and the 2A4 turret's square block) with the TTD's own fit; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
ttd.envelopeBasis: The as-built envelope of the fleet's Leopard 2 (the release hull, 3.67 m over its skirts, and the 2A4 turret with its sleeved L/44 tube 4.10 m ahead of the trunnion standing for the GT3's 51 calibres) under the TTD's own fit, as the owner asked; TE's 7.78 x 3.62 x 2.99 m TTD hull is 1 % narrower than the Leopard 2's and its 9.41 m over the gun 6 % shorter. The envelope holds the loader's FN MAG and the whips.
